_comment: This is the matching profile. Edit it, then EITHER paste the whole edited JSON into a GitHub Actions secret called PROFILE_JSON (recommended for public repos), OR copy this file to profile.json locally (it is gitignored). The agent prefers PROFILE_JSON, then profile.json, then this example.

profile.name: Aaron Kankipati
profile.currentRole: Senior Product Owner / Team Lead (Senior AVP), Wells Fargo
profile.summary: Product Owner and Team Lead with 7+ years in digital banking and fintech. End-to-end single-product ownership: discovery, user-story writing, backlog management, go-live. Currently leads two cross-geo Scrum teams on a Certificate of Deposits core-banking migration. Strong in regulated environments: change governance, release management, compliance, business readiness. Has independently built and shipped live AI products (Claude API, Cloudflare Workers, zero infra cost).
profile.seniority: Senior / AVP / Lead level, 7+ years. NOT interested in junior, associate, intern, graduate or entry-level roles.

preferences.values: Prefers regulated fintech / digital banking, genuine end-to-end product ownership, AI-focused products, and companies with a healthy, well-regarded culture. Values coaching, mentoring and clear product accountability.
preferences.dealbreakers: Pure delivery / project-management-only roles with no product ownership; heavy sales roles; relocation outside Hyderabad.
